**Enukuta:**

Ekibiina ekisooka kye ssomo ly'Essomabiramu, ekigendererwa kye kukulira obumanyirivu bw'abayizi ku kitera okubaawo ku miti gy'ebibala mu biseera by'omwaka eby'enjawulo. Okuba abaana bakwataganya omuti n'ekibala ekigugwanira (D) kye kitera okubawo obumanyirivu bwabwe. Kino kye kiyinza okukolebwa nga bayimiriza ku bufunze bw'omuti n'ekibala, n'okutegeera nti omuti gulimu ebibala mu biseera byaagwo eby'omwaka.

**Ebirala tebirina kukkirizibwa:**

*   **A:** Okuzimba omuti mu kapapula tekyayamba abayizi okutegeera ekitera okubaawo ku miti gy'ebibala mu biseera by'omwaka eby'enjawulo.
*   **B:** Okugigawula emiti mu miti egibala n'egitaliimu bibala tekyayamba abayizi okutegeera ekitera okubaawo ku miti gy'ebibala mu biseera by'omwaka eby'enjawulo.
*   **C:** Okukolela langi ku muti n'ekiseera kyagwo tekyayamba abayizi okutegeera ekitera okubaawo ku miti gy'ebibala mu biseera by'omwaka eby'enjawulo.

**Enukuta:**

Omukutu ogwa 4 ng'ogoberera enkola y'okunoonyereza, omusomesa ayagala okwogera ku ngeri ez'enjawulo ez'okwawula ebintu ebiri mu mugatte. Okutuukiriza kino, alaga abayizi be eccupa erimu amazzi, amayinja, amafuta, n’omunnyo. Omusomesa alina eccupa eziwerako ezitegekeddwa nga zirimu ebintu bye bimu. Ku mirimu egiddwa wano, gumu ku gyo gwonna gwandisobozesezza abayizi okuyiga ku nkola z’okwawula ebintu ebiri mu mugatte ate era ne bakulaakulanya obukugu bwabwe mu kukebera obutuufu bw’ebiva mu kunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi, era olukalu luno luba ku **B**.

**Ensonga:**

Mu ngeri zonna ezibiri, abayizi bagenda bakola ku nkola z'okwawula omugatte nga bakozesa obukodyo bwabwe, era ne balambulula okutuuka ku kigero ki obusobozi bwabwe okukola ekyo bwe bwali. Kino kiyamba abayizi okukulaakulanya obukugu bwabwe mu kukebera obutuufu bw'ebiva mu kunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi.

**Enukuta:**

Omusomesa yakubiriza abaana okukozesa **okuteebereza ebinaavaamu** (making predictions). Mu kibiina ky'okunoonyereza, okuteebereza ebinaavaamu kiba kiva mu kukubiriza abayizi okugamba kiki bwe bayinza okukola singa bakole ekintu ekitaliimu. Mu kino kaseera, abaana bayinza okuteebereza kiki bwe kinaabaawo singa bateeka ebikoola mu mazzi, nga bakozesa obumanyirivu bwabwe bw'okusooka. Okukebereza, okwekenneenya okukulemberwa, n'okugeraageranya ku bubaka bitera kukolebwa nga omulimu guli mu maaso, so tebiva mu kukubiriza abaana okugamba kiki bwe kinaabaawo.

D. Okugabanyika

**Explanation:**

The experiment demonstrates **density**. The sugar and glycerin are denser than water, causing them to sink to the bottom. The water, being less dense, floats on top. The teacher is illustrating how different substances separate based on their density – their mass per unit volume.  

* **A. Obungi bw'ekintu (Quantity of the substance):** The amount of each substance doesn't explain *why* they layer.
* **B. Obusobozi bw'ekintu okusaanuuka (Ability of the substance to dissolve):** Dissolving isn't the primary principle at play here.
* **C. Obuwewufu (Texture):** Texture doesn't explain the layering effect.

**Ekyanulo:**

Ebintu ebikola obudde biba nga bitwalira mu nkola z'omuyaga, obunnyogovu/obbugumu (temperature), n'enkuba.
